blocking.title: Texts describe pi's non-2xx body handling for all three refreshes as Codex's, which hides a measured divergence
blocking.detail: pi @ 1cedd3272 catches a failed answer's body read (response.text().catch(() => '')) only in openai-codex.ts. anthropic.ts postJson calls 'await response.text()' before its status check (:87) with no catch, and github-copilot.ts fetchJson calls 'await response.text()' uncaught (:200). So pi's Anthropic and Copilot refreshes report a 401/403/400 whose body is cut short, gzip-broken or stalled as 'TypeError: terminated' or a TimeoutError, which pi's retry pattern matches: pi RETRIES that refusal. aelix refuses it at once at all three sites (the goal's rule). These texts state otherwise or leave it out: ADR-0251 12.7 item 1 (~l.1278, 'pi reads a failed answer's body with response.text().catch'); 12.6 item 2 (~l.1190, 'pi keeps the status', said of all three providers); the StatusBeforeBody docstring (_helpers.py ~255-279), whose new round-5 'Known differences' list names only the two 2xx differences; 12.3 (no bullet for this); the commit message, round 4 item 1. Text-only fix: limit those statements to pi's Codex refresh, and state this divergence in 12.3, the docstring, 12.8 and the message.
